name: Shotcut
title: Shotcut: free Adobe Premiere alternative
caption:
Adobe Premiere costs $22.99/month to edit videos. Shotcut does it for free 🎬

✅ Multitrack timeline with thumbnails and waveforms
✅ Color wheels, chroma key, blur and 100+ video filters
✅ Keyframes for filter settings, plus audio and video fades
✅ Edits files directly with no import step, up to 4K

💻 Windows · Mac · Linux
ℹ️ Shotcut is a capable editor but has its own look, so expect a learning curve coming from Premiere. Adobe's $22.99/month is the Premiere-only plan, billed monthly on an annual commitment

Comment "VIDEO" and I'll DM you the link 🔗

dm_pitch: Shotcut, the free open-source video editor 🎬

beats.say: Creators pay two hundred seventy six dollars a year for something that's free.
And most of them have no clue.
Premiere charges twenty three bucks a month. Shotcut costs nothing.
You get a real timeline, with stacked tracks and waveforms on every clip.
Color wheels, green screen, and keyframes for every filter.
No import step, four K editing, and it runs on Windows, Mac and Linux.
It's Premiere, minus the monthly bill.
Comment Video, and I'll send you the link.
